Action: Deploy closed-loop tracking: server-side GTM, Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions, and HubSpot lifecycle stages uploaded as offline conversions.
Why / evidence: The dashboard cannot distinguish a cheap lead from a valuable member until CRM outcomes flow back to the ad platforms. Every optimisation below depends on this.
KPI moved: Offline match rate, CAC accuracy, LTV:CAC
Expected impact: Enables all later optimisation; removes false CAC signals

Action: Remove live Lorem Ipsum from the values and 300+ experts sections, standardise the review count to one verified figure, and rewrite the hero around one clear outcome.
Why / evidence: Placeholder copy and inconsistent proof (2,600 / 2,200 / 2,000 reviews) undermine trust on a high-consideration purchase and tax every paid click.
KPI moved: Landing page view rate, masterclass registration rate, CPL

Action: Build a masterclass reminder and replay sequence: SMS + email at T-24h, T-1h, live-start, and a 72-hour replay window with a booking CTA.
Why / evidence: Attendance is the largest funnel leak. Registrants who never attend cannot become members, so raising attendance is cheaper than buying more leads.
KPI moved: Attendance rate, cost per booked call, CAC

Action: Rebalance budget toward Search and Retargeting within demand and frequency caps; hold YouTube at a test budget until incrementality is proven.
Why / evidence: Search has the lowest CAC, and retargeting returns roughly 1.8x Meta prospecting's ROAS, yet both are under-funded relative to Meta prospecting and YouTube.

Action: Introduce a five-minute speed-to-lead SLA with round-robin routing, instant booking links and escalation alerts.
Why / evidence: Leads contacted under five minutes in the sample convert several times better than leads contacted after an hour.
KPI moved: Call booking rate, show rate, lead-to-member conversion

Action: Run a structured creative sprint: founder-led boom-location ads and data explainers versus testimonial and UGC; rotate the bottom quartile every two weeks.
Why / evidence: Founder and data angles outperform testimonial and UGC in the sample. Meta CPM is rising while CTR falls, a classic fatigue signal.

Action: Build predictive lead scoring v1 from CRM and engagement signals; use it for routing and as a value signal in ad platforms.
Why / evidence: Blended lead quality hides large differences by segment and source. A model lets sales work the top deciles first and media optimise for members.
KPI moved: Lead quality score, cost per member, sales efficiency

Action: Split nurture into segment-specific journeys for first-time investors, experienced investors and retirees, with different proof, offers and cadence.
Why / evidence: First-time investors convert at a lower rate and take longer, while experienced investors carry higher AOV. One generic journey under-serves both.
KPI moved: Lead-to-member conversion, days to convert, segment LTV:CAC

Action: Stand up a quarterly incrementality programme: geo holdouts for Meta and YouTube, conversion lift for retargeting, then a lightweight MMM.
Why / evidence: Last-click ROAS over-credits retargeting and brand search. Without holdouts, budget will keep flowing to the channels that take credit rather than create demand.

Action: Measure YouTube on incremental members and assisted revenue; use long-form founder content and retarget viewers who pass the 50% mark.
Why / evidence: YouTube carries the highest last-click CAC but skews to experienced investors and higher member value. Killing it on CAC alone would remove the top-of-funnel engine.
Expected impact: Defensible YouTube budget; better creative reuse

Action: Systematise post-settlement review requests and launch a member referral offer with tracked codes and a dashboard.
Why / evidence: Reviews and referrals are the lowest-CAC acquisition sources and reinforce the trust proof already on the website.
KPI moved: Blended CAC, referral share of members, review volume

Action: Build a data-led content hub around boom locations, suburb research and investor education, with gated reports for lead capture.
Why / evidence: The site already has differentiated research and founder authority. Compounding organic demand lowers blended CAC and supports paid efficiency.
KPI moved: Organic sessions, assisted revenue, blended CAC
Expected impact: 10-20% of leads from organic within 6 months

Action: Launch a broker, accountant and buyer's-agent partnership programme with tracked referrals and co-branded masterclasses.
Why / evidence: Adjacent professionals already hold the trust of the target segments and can deliver pre-qualified, low-CAC introductions.

Action: Productionise this dashboard on live data, add data-quality tests, and assign owners and review cadence for every KPI in the dictionary.
Why / evidence: A dashboard without ownership and data-quality checks becomes shelfware. Weekly review is where the findings turn into budget decisions.
